# Convergence Themed — Theme Reference

<!-- Generated by theme-kit/tools/build_reference.py from assets/themes/default.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every id and key a theme can use, with the built-in names. Ids on the left never change; a theme replaces
the names on the right. Give this file to an AI together with a prompt from AI_PROMPTS.md.

- **resource A** is mined from crystal moons by freighters. **resource B** comes from asteroid fields via mining stations.
- **Weapon keys** (`beam1`, `bolt2`, `torp1`…): `beam` = continuous beam, `bolt` = cannon/bolt, `torp` = torpedo/missile.
- **Ability keys** end in a number when a faction has more than one of that type (`cloak`, `cloak2`).
- `t1_launched` exists only for factions with carriers. `t2b` exists only for Concord.

Ability types: `cloak` (invisibility), `shield_boost` (damage reduction), `torpedo_barrage` (projectile volley),
`absorb` (take over a disabled ship), `tractor_beam` (hold a ship), `boarding` (kill crew / capture),
`launch_fighters` (spawn fighter wings), `jump` (short teleport), `aoe_blast` (area damage),
`repair_field` (heal nearby), `sensor_pulse` (reveal area), `crew_blast` (kill crews in an area).

## Region: Meridian Sector

### `concord` — Concord of Worlds (short: Concord)

*Play style:* Balanced fleets with strong shields, lance arrays and seeker torpedoes. Excellent repair support.

- resourceA: Aurorite · resourceB: Duralloy · color: `6FC8FF`
- weapons: `beam1` Lance Emitter, `beam2` Lance Array, `bolt1` Pulse Lance, `torp1` Singularity Torpedo, `torp2` Seeker Torpedo, `beam3` Heavy Lance, `beam4` Lance Banks, `beam5` Heavy Lance Array, `beam6` Prime Lance Array, `beam7` Point-defense Lance
